name: enrich-waterfall
description: Fixed 17-call, read-only person and company enrichment bundle across Apollo, Hunter, Scrape Creators (LinkedIn), Company Enrich, Brave Search, Diffbot KG, Clado contacts, and SELAT-native X/Twitter. Requires a complete, coherent target; every step runs independently — no conditional waterfall. Uses MPP on Tempo and x402 through the SELAT Router.

email.description: Known work email for the same person identified by firstName, lastName, linkedinUrl, company, and domain. The final verifier checks this supplied email.

firstName.description: Target person's first name, matching email and linkedinUrl.

lastName.description: Target person's last name, matching email and linkedinUrl.

domain.description: Bare employer/company domain, e.g. stripe.com, matching company and email; also filters the Apollo people-search.

company.description: Employer/company name corresponding to domain and organizationId.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn person-profile URL for the same target, used by Apollo people enrichment, the Scrape Creators profile read, and Clado contact enrichment.

organizationId.description: Apollo organization ID for the same company. The runner cannot derive it from an earlier step, so supply it before the run.

xHandle.description: Target person's X/Twitter username without @, matching the same identity.

steps.label: person cross-check — Apollo people enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
person by supplied email — Hunter email enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
person by supplied LinkedIn URL — Scrape Creators LinkedIn profile (MPP on Tempo)
person plus company by supplied email — Hunter combined enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
company search by supplied name, 5 results — Apollo org search (MPP on Tempo)
company profile by supplied domain — Company Enrich (MPP on Tempo)
company tech and headcount — Apollo org enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
company cross-check — Hunter company enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
find target work email — Hunter email finder (MPP on Tempo)
X/Twitter profile by supplied handle — SELAT user info (x402 via Circle Gateway)
job openings (10) by supplied Apollo organization ID — Apollo job postings (MPP on Tempo)
recent company news — Brave news search (MPP on Tempo)
recent funding news — Brave news search (MPP on Tempo)
organization knowledge graph — Diffbot KG enhance (MPP on Tempo)
contact email and phone reveal — Clado contacts (MPP on Tempo)
five-result person identity search filtered to the supplied domain — Apollo people-search (MPP on Tempo)
verify supplied work email — Hunter email verifier (MPP on Tempo)
